integrity: The exact period is proved from the published factorized Alexander polynomial by a squarefreeness, coprimality, primitive-root, and least-common-multiple argument. A finite symbolic check through n=20 is only a sanity check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns only the integral first-homology action of the fiber monodromy. It does not compute the pseudo-Anosov stretch factor, Johnson homomorphisms, or the Johnson-filtration depth of the minimal Torelli power, and it does not identify the knot's unique strong inversion with a monodromy symmetry.
title: Exact homological period for the Kegel–Teragaito knot family
